t: Thermostatic mixer shower with deluge head and separate hand shower. Separate temperature and flow controls enable fine tuning whilst showering. Magni-flow technology gives powerful performance and delivers high flow rate, even at low pressure. Thermostatic shower stability helps to ensure safe showering for all the family and Coolshield ensures the valve does not get hot.
b: Suitable for High & Low Water Pressure Systems
